learning_outcomes.text: Knows the concept of fluid and general terminology related to fluids
Understands the behavior of the fluid in the static state
Learn how to apply Bernoulli's law to fluids.
Can establish the relationship between fluid and energy
Develops equations describing fluid flow in both integral and differential form and solves simple flow problems.
Be able to perform momentum analysis of flow systems.

syllabus_topics: General information, units, properties and classification of fluids
Fluid statics, Pressure types and measurements, Analysis of gravity induced pressure field
Determination of hydrostatic pressure forces acting on submerged surfaces
Fluids in motion, Basic analysis techniques of flows
Steady and unsteady flows, Fundamental concepts of streamlines, stream tubes and acceleration
Dynamics of inviscid incompressible fluids, laminar and turbulent flows
Conservation of mass, Euler, Bernoulli equations
Conservation of mass, Euler, Bernoulli equations
Applications of Bernoulli equation, problem solving
Friction losses and flow in pipes
Determination of losses in piping systems
Dimensional analysis and experimental fluid mechanics
bibliography: Akışkanlar Mekaniği Temelleri ve Uygulamaları, Yunus A. Çengel. Michael A. Boles, Literatür Yayıncılık.
